api_notes: Census International Trade API is free with a registered key at api.census.gov; endpoints /data/timeseries/intltrade/exports/hs and /imports/hs, monthly, HS10 detail, district and country dimensions. BEA API (apps.bea.gov/api/data) is free with a key and serves ITA (international services trade) and GDPbyIndustry datasets. USITC DataWeb requires a free login for bulk pulls but has a documented REST endpoint.

Note: the WDS endpoint timed out for my fetcher during verification while the documented user guide and table pages resolved 200 - throttle and retry with a real user agent.

IBGE SIDRA (apisidra.ibge.gov.br, servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados) and www.ibge.gov.br returned HTTP 503 to every attempt on 2026-09-04, so IBGE URLs are deliberately EXCLUDED as unverified - retry later; SIDRA is normally free and keyless and covers PMC retail and PMS services.
